description: This file defines a PHP class named PayGradeSearchFilterParams that extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to specify filtering and sorting parameters for searching pay grades within the OrangeHRM system, including setting a default sort field.

classes.name: PayGradeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used to encapsulate filtering parameters for searching pay grades, with predefined allowed sort fields and default sort setting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a default sort field set to 'pg.name'.
